name: Viva Goods Company Limited
summary: Viva Goods Company Limited, established in 2000 and headquartered in Hong Kong, is an investment holding company formerly named Viva China Holdings Limited until 2023. Its multi-brand apparel and footwear segment designs and sells clothing and shoes under brands including Clarks, bossini and Li-Ning. Its sports experience segment operates sports parks, centers, ice rinks and e-sports clubs, organizes events and provides sports marketing services, with markets across the UK, Ireland, the US, China and other regions.
